118
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 23, 2006/Bhadrapada 1, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —20
ISI activities in Kashmir Valley
*381. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether irrespective of Government's
peace initiative and Prime Minister's
invitation to Kashmiri separatist leaders for
round table conference, ISI refuses to stop
its nefarious activities in valley;
(b) if so, whether according to reports,
ISI is promoting three terrorist outfits and
has directed the commanders of Lashkar-
e-Tayeba and A1-Badar to continue attacks;
(c) whether ISI has increased
remuneration to terrorist outfits as a reward
for their activities;
(d) whether several attacks, bomb
blasts and killing of tourists on 11th July
and earlier are result of such activities;
and
(e) whether this has forced India to
delay proposed ministerial talks with
Pakistan?
Delay in finalisation of
Defence Plans
*382.   SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
finalisation of 10th Defence Plan was
delayed;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have taken
cognizance of the media reports
apprehending delay in 11th Defence Plan
too;
(d) if so, does Government agree with
media reports;
(e) if so, reasons for the delay;
(f) whether it is a fact that inter-service
rivalry has been one of the causes of delay
in finalising the Defence Plans; and
(g) if so, what steps are being taken to
finalise the Defence Plan in time?

119
Employment in Private Sector
Industries under NREGA
†*383. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that private sector
industries have assured to provide
employment under National Rural
Employment Guarantee Act;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reaction of Government thereto?
Construction of ponds under NREG
Scheme in Gujarat
†*384. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 200 cubic
meter ponds were made in Gujarat through
National Rural Employment Guarantee
Scheme under monitoring of farmers which
created an extra capacity of 2.54 crore cubic
meter water storage;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that due to
this scheme the water problem being faced
by the farmers has been addressed upto
some extent; and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto and whether Government propose
to contemplate to implement this model at
national level?
Smooth crossing of Wagha
Border
*385. SHRI TARLOCHAN SINGH:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) how many persons crossed Wagha
Border by road during the last two years,
month-wise;
(b) what is the average time taken in
clearance of one person;
(c) what steps are being taken to
strengthen the staff there; and
(d) whether Government would open a
separate line at Wagha for easy flow of
trade?
Increase in naxal activities
†*386. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that naxalite
activities have increased in forests areas of
naxal affected States Jharkhand,
Chhattisgarh, Orissa, Andhra Pradesh,
Bihar and Madhya Pradesh since the year
2003;
(b) whether coordinated and integrated
efforts to check the said activities in naxal
affected States could not be made due to
the lenient attitude of Central Government
and some State Governments towards
them; and
(c) whether any intense campaign to
get rid of the said problem is under
consideration of Government; if not, the
reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

120
Threat to Kashmiri Pandits by
Terrorists in Valley
*387. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Kashmiri
Pandits have been forced to declare
performance of ‘Mahashradh’ in Jammu
instead of valley in view of threats from
terrorists; and
(b) if so, whether Government will
ensure that they are able to return to
valley at least for such acts?
Compensation to farmers for laying
mines
*388. SHRI T. S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether full and final compensation
have since been paid to all the eligible
farmers whose lands were used for laying
mines etc. by the army on the Indo-Pak
border in J&K especially in Ranbir Singh
Pura Sector;
(b) whether any claims are still
pending; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

(a) whether Government are going to

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 23, 2006/Bhadrapada 1, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —155
Private promoters in SEZs
2724. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how many private promoters are in
Special Economic Zones;
(b) their names and areas where they
are developers;
(c) how much land each of them have
acquired in each Zone and per acre paid by
them; and
(d) at what price will they be selling
land to entrepreneurs in these zones?
Pending proposals for
Industrialization in Tamil Nadu
2725. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the proposals pending before
Government for industrialisation, trade
promotion and setting up of new industries
for over all economic development of  Tamil
Nadu; and
(b) by when these proposals are likely
to be approved?
Import export with Bangladesh and
vice versa
2726. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the names of items which are
imported to India from Bangladesh and
those which are exported from India to
Bangladesh as per trade agreement between
the two countries;
(b) which of those items have been
settled up by the present Government;
(c) whether Government have been
contemplating setting up open markets at
the border, for the benefit of the local
producers and to dilute the smuggling
tendency among some sections of traders;
(d) if so, the details of the programme
in that regard; and

630
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Impact of FDI on agriculture and
plantation
2727. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have taken a decision to allow FDI upto
100 per cent in agriculture/plantation
activities;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have taken into
consideration the fact that if FDI is
permitted, the prices of agricultural products
would not be controllable; and
(d) the other consequence which the
people of India would have to face due to
this?
Doubling the trade between India and
Thailand
2728. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and
Thailand are exploring opportunities to
double the annual trade to 4 billion dollar in
the next couple of years, and expand the
list of items that could be traded, from 82
to about 5,000;
(b) whether a working group from
Thailand had discussions with the
concerned officials here to double the trade
volume from two billion dollar to four
billion dollar; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Import of vanaspati from Sri Lanka
2729. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether import of vanaspati from
Sri Lanka is duty free under the Free Trade
Agreement ;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is any policy for
controlling, regulating and for proper
distribution of the imported vanaspati;
(d) if so, whether NAFED is associated
with the above distribution;
(e) whether the Directorate of
Vanaspati, Vegetable Oils and Fats has
recommended fixation of Tariff rate Quota
(TRQ) for duty free import of Vanaspati;
(f) if so, the action taken on above
recommendation; and
(g) the steps taken to protect the
domestic vanaspati industry from the
impact of the duty free import?
Certification for arecanut import by
CPCRI
2730. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Plantation
Crops Research Institute (CPCRI) has
certified during 2006 that the arecanut
imported are of inferior quality;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there is any regulatory body
to control arecanut import and check its
quality; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
whether steps would be taken to constitute
such a body?

631
China-India trade
2731. PROF. P.J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that China-India
trade will surpass the target of $20 billion
before the financial year 2008;
(b) whether it is a fact that a vast portion
of exports from India consist of raw
materials like iron ore, etc;
(c) what steps would be taken by
Government to encourage and help change
the profile of our exports to China; and
(d) the steps proposed to involve the
industry and various institutions, to come
up with solutions to improve the quality
and value of our exports to China?
Funds for industrial development of
Uttaranchal
2732. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds allocated for
industrial development for hilly and
backward areas of Uttaranchal during the
